name: Maria Isabel Santos
headline: Customer Success Specialist
summary: Customer Success professional with 4 years of experience driving client onboarding, retention, and satisfaction for SaaS companies. Skilled in managing CRM pipelines, resolving support tickets via Zendesk, and building strong client relationships to reduce churn and improve product adoption.

responsibilities: Managed onboarding process for new SaaS clients, ensuring smooth product adoption
Maintained and updated client records in CRM system to track engagement and renewals
Resolved customer inquiries and technical issues using Zendesk ticketing system
Collaborated with product team to relay client feedback for feature improvements
Conducted quarterly business reviews with key accounts to assess satisfaction
Led end-to-end onboarding for enterprise clients, reducing time-to-value by streamlining processes
Managed CRM data hygiene and reporting for a portfolio of 80+ accounts
Handled escalated support tickets in Zendesk, coordinating with technical teams for resolution
Developed onboarding documentation and training materials for new customers
Monitored customer health scores to proactively identify churn risks
